# Aaron Family Livestock

> Aaron Family Livestock LLC is a registered Angus show cattle and genetics program in Gladewater, Texas, focused on AI sires, embryo calves, foundation females, and family-raised cattle bred for the show ring.

## Core Documentation
- [Home](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/): Overview of Aaron Family Livestock, registered Angus genetics, show record, and contact information.
- [Sires and Genetics](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/#sires): Featured AI sires, embryo genetics, donor females, and foundation cow families.
- [About](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/#about): Family background, Gladewater location, and program philosophy.

## Products & Services
- [AI and Embryo Genetics](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/#sires): Circle S Moxy 406, Colburn Primo 5153, El Jefe, Silveiras Style 9303, Circle S 5707, and Phat Amy daughter genetics.
- [Show Cattle Program](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/#show-record): Show record highlights and cattle raised with a family-first approach.

## About & Authority
- [Show Record](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/#show-record): Competitive cattle achievements including San Angelo, Cowgirls in Cowtown, and JBBA National highlights.
- [Contact](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/#contact): Contact Bryan Aaron or Vance Aaron for questions about the program.

## Contact
- [Contact](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/#contact): Reach Aaron Family Livestock in Gladewater, Texas.
